'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
****Ten [[Palestinians]], including three people who were seeking [[humanitarian aid]], are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]] ahead of peace talks in [[Egypt]], bringing the total number of Palestinians killed in Israeli attacks since Friday up to 104. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/6/potential-hurdles-litter-road-as-israel-and-hamas-head-to-gaza-peace-talks (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[SDF–Syrian Transitional Government clashes (2025–present)|SDF–Syrian Transitional Government clashes]]
***Clashes erupt between [[Syrian transitional government|Syrian government]] troops and [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]] militias affiliated with the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] in [[Sheikh Maqsood]], [[Aleppo]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/10/07/heavy-clashes-break-out-between-syrian-and-kurdish-forces-in-aleppo (Alarabiya English)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**More than 40 people are killed, including children, and about 80 others are injured in a strike on a festival and an anti-junta protest in [[Chaung-U]], [[Sagaing Region]], Myanmar. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2025-10-08/dozens-killed-in-myanmar-military-strike-on-festival/105868620 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornadoes of 2025|2025 tornado season]]
**[[2025 Enderlin tornado]]
***The U.S. [[National Weather Service]] upgrades the rating of the tornado near [[Enderlin, North Dakota]], on June 20 this year, to EF5, the most recent tornado to attain the highest rating on the [[Enhanced Fujita scale]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2025/10/06/weather/the-us-records-its-first-ef5-tornado-in (CNN)]
*Three people are killed after an 80-year-old residential structure collapses in [[Veraval]], [[Gir Somnath district]], [[India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/ahmedabad/gujarat-veraval-city-80-year-old-house-collapse-10290833/?ref=archive_pg (''The Indian Express'')]
* A migrant boat carrying at least ten Chinese nationals capsized on the [[Danube]] river in the area of [[Bačka Palanka]], [[Vojvodina]], [[Serbia]], while en route to [[Croatia]]. One person was killed and nine others were rescued. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/chinese-migrant-dies-boat-capsizes-danube-serbia-croatia-126243061 (ABC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Donald Trump's September 2025 Gaza Strip proposal]]
***Indirect talks between [[Hamas]] and [[Israel]] begin in [[Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt|Sharm el-Sheikh]], [[Egypt]], to negotiate field conditions for the release of the remaining [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostages]] in return for an undetermined number of Palestinian prisoners. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c708l7vgwywo (BBC News)]
*[[Australia–Papua New Guinea relations]]
**[[Australia]] and [[Papua New Guinea]] sign a [[defense treaty]], formally granting Australia access to [[Papua New Guinea Defence Force|Papuan military]] facilities and requiring mutual defense in case of aggression. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp9824r3p31o (BBC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/australia-papua-new-guinea-defense-treaty-china-cb6d0c8b822673b02d2a20f6e560adab (AP)]
*[[New Zealand–Samoa relations]]
**[[New Zealand]] announces that it has paid a [[New Zealand dollar|NZ$]]6 million compensation to [[Samoa]] over the sinking of the [[HMNZS Manawanui (2019)|HMNZS ''Manawanui'']] off the coast of [[Upolu]] in October 2024. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/national/575097/new-zealand-pays-samoa-6m-over-grounding-of-hmnzs-manawanui (RNZ)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 deployment of federal forces in the United States]]
**[[United States federal judge]] [[Karin Immergut]] temporarily blocks the [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] from deploying [[National Guard (United States)|National Guard]] troops from [[California]] and [[Texas]] to [[Portland, Oregon]], saying there is no evidence that the city requires any [[Federal government of the United States|federal]] military intervention. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c740elm70z7o (BBC News)]
*[[Mexican drug war]], [[Mexico–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Treasury]] issues sanctions against various [[Mexico|Mexican]] companies, including those in the pharmaceutical, real estate, chemical, and cleaning sectors, and eight people who manage them for allegedly supplying [[drug precursors]] to the ''Chapitos'' faction of the [[Sinaloa Cartel]]. [https://apnews.com/article/fentanyl-mexico-sinaloa-cartel-chapitos-similab-us-sanctions-451840fb9ae5ebc637016ad69d7f2899 (AP)]
*At least 14 soldiers are killed and five others are injured in a [[shootout]] after a suspected "love triangle" dispute in [[South Sudan]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/love-triangle-soldiers-killed-south-sudan-army/ (CBS News)]
*A man opens fire inside an [[Appeals courts of Albania|appeals courts]] in [[Tirana]], [[Albania]], killing the presiding [[judge]] and injuring two others in the [[courtroom]]. [[Law enforcement in Albania|Police]] later arrest the suspect. [https://apnews.com/article/albania-judge-shot-dead-during-trial-9c6b79adfad08cc1654367717e85bdac (AP)]
*A person opens fire inside the [[Iberville Parish Courthouse]] in [[Iberville Parish, Louisiana|Iberville Parish]], [[Louisiana]], United States, killing a deputy and injuring another, before being fatally shot. [https://www.katc.com/deputy-killed-another-wounded-in-courthouse-shooting-in-iberville-parish (KATC)] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/10/2-deputies-wounded-in-louisiana-courthouse-shooting/ (BNO News)]
*The [[International Criminal Court investigation in Darfur|International Criminal Court]] convicts [[Janjaweed]] commander [[Ali Kushayb]] of [[war crimes]] in [[War in Darfur|Darfur]], [[Sudan]], including rape, murder, and persecution. Kushayb is the first [[militia]] leader to be convicted for these [[war crimes]]. His sentence will be determined in a later hearing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/icc-convicts-first-darfur-militia-leader-war-crimes-2025-10-06/ (Reuters)]
*A group of [[human rights organizations]] in [[Myanmar]] file a joint lawsuit against [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[telecommunications|telecoms]] firm [[Telenor]] for allegedly sharing customer data with the [[Tatmadaw]] after the [[2021 Myanmar coup d'état|2021 coup d'état]] and in the [[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|civil war]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/7/myanmar-activists-to-sue-norways-telenor-for-handing-data-to-military (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/myanmar-groups-to-sue-telenor-over-data-sharing-with-junta (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
* A [[2025 Alberta teachers' strike|teachers' strike in Alberta]] begins, making 51,000 teachers off-work and affects more than 700,000 students. Thousands rally across Alberta to support educators [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/edmonton/alberta-public-education-rally-teachers-strike-1.7651669 (CBC)] [https://globalnews.ca/video/11465676/alberta-teachers-rally-on-legislature-steps-ahead-of-strike/ (Global News)] [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/article-edmonton-rally-alberta-teachers-strike/ (The Globe and Mail)]
*[[2024–2025 French political crisis]]
**[[First Lecornu government]]
***[[France|French]] [[Prime Minister of France|prime minister]] [[Sébastien Lecornu]] resigns after 27 days of being in office. With only 14 hours between the appointment of ministers and his resignation, Lecornu becomes the shortest-serving Prime Minister [[List of prime ministers of France|in French history]]. [https://www.bfmtv.com/politique/gouvernement/direct-le-nouveau-gouvernement-peine-nomme-deja-condamne-bruno-retailleau-convoque-une-reunion-d-urgence-des-lr-premier-conseil-des-ministres-a-16h_LN-202510060066.html (BFMTV)] [https://www.liberation.fr/politique/quatorze-heures-demission-comprise-le-desastre-annonce-du-gouvernement-lecornu-20251006_LNP376GAR5HZFBBL2GDRNWJDHA/ (''Libération'')]
*[[2025 Malagasy protests]]
**[[Generation Z|Youth]]-led protests against [[List of presidents of Madagascar|President]] [[Andry Rajoelina]] resume across [[Madagascar]], with clashes with [[riot police]] taking place in multiple cities, including the capital [[Antananarivo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/anti-government-protests-resume-several-madagascar-cities-2025-10-06/ (Reuters)]
**[[President of Madagascar|President]] [[Andry Rajoelina]] appoints [[Ruphin Fortunat Zafisambo]], a [[Madagascar Armed Forces]] [[General officer|general]], as the new [[Prime Minister of Madagascar|prime minister of Madagascar]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/madagascar-president-names-military-general-new-prime-minister-2025-10-06/ (Reuters)]
